item.title: The Lightswitch (Rewrite, seeking Greenlight)
item.content:encoded:
An SCP is lost under questionable circumstances. An investigation begins to reveal lies within the Foundation.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlight: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Mystery

Page Layout (Optional): Brief SCP article warning not to look into it (some sort of memetic hazard), most of the content being behind a high clearance level Addendum.

Elevator Pitch: A body-stealing lightswitch is handed around between various GOI’s that allows someone to forcibly take control of another.

Central Narrative: Created by a failed anartist, the UIU collected it from an anomalous smuggler trying to pawn over various low-level anomalies for a quick buck. The smuggler mysteriously vanished, and the UIU soon discovered it had the ability to allow people to enter the bodies of others (essentially controlling them and allowing access to their memories), and almost immediately it became a high priority target from the Foundation and other GOI’s.

+ show block
– hide block

After a series of raids, exchanges, purchases and various under-the-table dealings it finally lands in the Foundation's hands. It gets stolen once more (all too easily, its theft generates a lot of discontent with the Site Manager/containment directors complaining of higher up meddling), but the Foundation’s upper brass immediately demand they cease all investigation/pursuit attempts on it.

Soon after, the Foundation begins launching a series of extremely successful raids on other GOI’s, all ordered from the top brass only (with little communication to various MTF commanders/field directors). This isn’t unheard of (espionage naturally being confidential), but it does begin to grow concern of the lack of communication. A low level Researcher, Dr. Jonathan Moyer, looks more into the situation.

He starts pulling back layers and layers of lies, revealing that all the times the SCP hopped from GOI to GOI it was meticulously logged by the Foundation. He discovers that the UIU never actually discovered it, rather it was left on their doorstep one day. Turns out, the anartist who created it never existed, and at this point Dr. Moyer is closing in on the truth; all signs are pointing at the Foundation’s upper brass having far more influence than previously thought. As he starts following this trail to its end, he is suddenly killed during a containment breach of a seperate SCP he was working with. The top brass claim the breach was sabotage by the Chaos Insurgency, and refuse to allow anyone to look into it.

After this, the containment procedures are appended to include a (false) addendum mentioning an anti-memetic hazard, or some other nonsense to have people stop looking into it.

Hook/Attention Grabber: Explicit warnings not to look into it are up front, early on in the article. The warnings seem to have shaky reasoning to begin with.


As a courtesy to our readers on mobile devices, please collapse long posts. ~Zyn
